title: Busan shark remains unsighted for 11 days after monthlong stay in canal
caption:
Bukang-i the shark spent over a month in a coastal canal in Busan, drawing massive crowds. After 11 days without a sighting, experts believe the animal has finally returned to the open ocean.

Source: Koreaherald - Busan shark remains unsighted for 11 days after monthlong stay in canal
